change: crates/incular-widgets/src/animated_size.rs: AnimatedSize::reverse_duration builder and reverse_duration_value getter; forwarded to the controller with set_reverse_duration at creation and on update.
harness: none; Flutter only runs the size animation forward, so no frame difference exists.
note: Reclassified from invalid: source compatibility is cheap here.

root_cause: No DeviceGestureSettings: every recognizer used kTouchSlop and kPanSlop regardless of the platform.
change: incular-core DeviceGestureSettings (touch_slop, pan_slop, from_physical); incular-gestures slop.rs compute_hit_slop/compute_pan_slop take settings, and the pointer, scale, tap-and-drag, multi-tap, multi-drag and force-press recognizers store them; incular-config RuntimeEnvironment::gesture_settings; incular-widgets tree gesture_settings_at hands the nearest MediaQuery settings to detector, scale and scroll-drag recognizers. trackpadScrollCausesScale was fixed in the gestures-api pass.
harness: gestures__ 11/11 match; no scenario overrides the slop.
api_change: added DeviceGestureSettings, RuntimeEnvironment::gesture_settings, public compute_hit_slop/compute_pan_slop and set_gesture_settings/gesture_settings on recognizers
limitations: No Android or iOS host exists to report a platform touch slop; desktop and web report none, as Flutter embedders do.

root_cause: The Router back dispatcher was a flat callback list with no child dispatchers, so a nested Router could not take priority.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/app_shell/router.rs: BackButtonDispatcher gains children and a parent (create_child, defer_to, forget, take_priority, has_callbacks); new ChildBackButtonDispatcher with take_priority; dispatch_back consults prioritized children newest first and then callbacks; dropping a child last callback forgets it; RouterConfig::with_back_button_dispatcher takes impl Into<BackButtonDispatcher>.
harness: none; no frame scenario drives Router back priority.
api_change: added ChildBackButtonDispatcher and BackButtonDispatcher child methods; RouterConfig::back_button_dispatcher returns Option<BackButtonDispatcher>

root_cause: No TransitionDelegate: the outlet animated every added page in and kept a replaced top under its replacement, regardless of the update.
change: crates/incular-navigation/src/transition_delegate.rs: TransitionDelegate, DefaultTransitionDelegate, PageTransition, PageRouteRecord, ExitingPageRoute, PageEntering, PageExiting, PageTransitionDecisions; Navigator::set_transition_delegate, clear_transition_delegate, take_page_transitions; set_pages builds the records with locations and runs the delegate outside the borrow. crates/incular-runtime/src/route_outlet.rs: drive_route_animations consumes the decisions; ExitPlacement replaces below/until.
harness: navigation__ 6/12, the same six documented divergences; no scenario drives set_pages.
api_change: added the transition delegate types and Navigator methods
limitations: Pageless routes do not exist in Incular, so Flutter pageRouteToPagelessRoutes has no counterpart. Complete and Remove both leave at once because routes carry no completion result.
note: Behavior change: set_pages now animates only the new top and drops a replaced top at once, as Flutter default does.

root_cause: CustomPainter had no semantics builder, so painted regions had no semantic nodes.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/custom_paint.rs: CustomPainter::semantics_builder (default None), CustomPainterSemantics (rect, key, Semantics properties), SemanticsBuilder; PainterDelegate keeps the builder. crates/incular-widgets/src/layout/basic/painting.rs: CustomPaint adds a pointer-ignoring Positioned::fill LayoutBuilder layer per painter that places one Semantics node per region at the laid-out size, ordered background regions, child, foreground regions.
harness: new scenario semantics__custom_paint_regions: match; semantics__ 19/20 (enabled_default known), paint 9/9.
limitations: shouldRebuildSemantics, CustomPainterSemantics.transform and tags are not ported; regions rebuild with the widget.

root_cause: Images loaded synchronously from a handle; there was no loading state for frame, loading or error builders to observe.
change: crates/incular-image/src/stream.rs: ImageStream, ImageStreamCompleter, ImageLoadState, ImageChunkEvent, AnyImageProvider; ImageProvider::resolve defaults to a completed stream. crates/incular-widgets/src/provider_image.rs: ProviderImage (Image::provider) with frame/loading/error builders, gapless playback, semantics, re-resolution on provider or configuration change. crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/descriptors.rs: shared ImageOptions and option setters.
harness: pixels --incular-only: image scenes unchanged (image_default_fit@1.25 diff shared with decoration_image_default_fit).
api_change: added ImageStream, ImageStreamCompleter, ImageLoadState, ImageChunkEvent, AnyImageProvider, ImageProvider::resolve, Image::provider, ProviderImage, ImageFrameBuilder, ImageLoadingBuilder, ImageErrorBuilder
limitations: single-frame images only; no TickerMode pausing; chunks arrive as loading states rather than a separate listener.

root_cause: FadeInImage took handles only and lacked error builders and per-image colors.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/fade_in_image.rs: provider sources through ProviderImage, image/placeholder error builders, colors and blend modes, match_text_direction; synchronous loads skip the fade. crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/descriptors.rs: Image color and color_blend_mode lowered to ColorFiltered.
api_change: added FadeInImage::from_providers, image_error_builder, placeholder_error_builder, image_color, image_color_blend_mode, placeholder_color, placeholder_color_blend_mode, match_text_direction; Image::color, Image::color_blend_mode

root_cause: Scroll positions had no minimum extent and the sequence viewport laid every sliver forward from offset zero, so there was no center or anchor.
change: crates/incular-scroll: ScrollState.min_offset, ScrollController::min_offset, ViewportMetricsUpdate::leading/with_leading, min-aware clamping, ballistics, settling, range maintaining, metrics and scrollbar geometry. crates/incular-widgets/src/scrolling/layout.rs: SequenceRenderSliver::layout_run, ViewportCenter, SequenceViewportDelegate::centered and layout_centered (port of RenderViewport._attemptLayout). geometry.rs: SliverViewportLayout leading_extent/reverse_slivers. tree/layout/behavior/sliver.rs: publishes the leading extent, keeps reverse children's trailing edge. sliver_descriptors.rs: CustomScrollView/Viewport center and anchor; ShrinkWrappingViewport controller, axis and reverse. Widget drag, fling, keyboard, semantics, raw scrollbar and ensure_visible honor min_offset.
harness: new twin slivers__viewport_center__anchor: all probes, offset and max match; min diverges by up to 18 px while unmeasured (Flutter re-estimates, Incular keeps measured extents). slivers__ otherwise 15/16 (known keep-alive); scroll twins unchanged before/after.
api_change: added ScrollController::min_offset, ViewportMetricsUpdate::leading and with_leading, ScrollbarGeometry::min_scroll_extent, RawScrollbarGeometry::min_scroll_extent/scroll_range/offset_at, CustomScrollView::center/anchor, Viewport::center/anchor, ShrinkWrappingViewport::controller/axis_direction/reverse; exported ShrinkWrappingViewport and Viewport from the facade
limitations: center is named by index, not key; no centerOffsetAdjustment; centered viewports with reverse slivers lay out on every scroll.

root_cause: Image resolution never consulted scroll activity: positions had no activity velocity, physics had no recommendDeferredLoading, and descendants could not find their scrollable.
change: crates/incular-scroll: ScrollPhysics::recommend_deferred_loading, OwnedActivity::set_velocity, ScrollController::activity_velocity and recommend_deferred_loading (activity velocity + jump-implied velocity cleared post-frame). crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/interaction.rs: fling/animate driver records simulation velocity. tree/reconciliation.rs: Scroll and SliverViewport elements provide ScrollableScope. scroll_aware_image_provider.rs: Scrollable::recommend_deferred_loading_for_context, ScrollAwareContext, ScrollAwareImageProvider (frame-callback retry). provider_image.rs: every resolution wrapped, context disposed on replace/drop. crates/incular-image/src/stream.rs: ImageStreamCompleter::follow, AnyImageProvider::load_with and Eq.
harness: none: deferral is only observable for images appearing mid-fling and the harness has no async image provider on either side.
api_change: added ScrollPhysics::recommend_deferred_loading, OwnedActivity::set_velocity, ScrollController::activity_velocity, ScrollController::recommend_deferred_loading, Scrollable::recommend_deferred_loading_for_context, ScrollAwareContext, ScrollAwareImageProvider, ImageStreamCompleter::follow, AnyImageProvider::load_with, impl Eq for AnyImageProvider
limitations: no provider-keyed image cache, so Flutter's cached-key shortcut does not apply; no axis filter.
note: Flutter's threshold is the view's longest physical side, not the max fling velocity.

root_cause: incular-assets had only memory, directory and caching bundles, and no asynchronous load path.
change: crates/incular-assets/src/network.rs: AssetFetcher (injected, non-blocking fetch plus optional fetch_blocking), AssetResponse, NetworkAssetBundle, resolve_url (Dart Uri.resolve). bundle.rs: AssetBundle::load_async (default synchronous), CachingAssetBundle forwards it.
api_change: added AssetFetcher, AssetFetchCallback, AssetLoadCallback, AssetResponse, NetworkAssetBundle, resolve_url, AssetBundle::load_async
limitations: The transport is application-supplied because incular-assets may not depend on an HTTP client. Synchronous load needs a blocking fetcher. No PlatformAssetBundle or loadBuffer.

root_cause: Text field histories were only reachable from keyboard shortcuts; there was no platform undo command or undo-state channel.
change: crates/incular-platform/src/undo_manager.rs: UndoDirection, UndoManagerCommand::SetUndoState; PlatformEvent::Undo. crates/incular-runtime/src/frame.rs: handle_platform_undo (focused field is the client, runs the Undo/Redo text intent), sync_undo_manager_state (iOS only, on focus and change), take_undo_manager_commands. application.rs: per-window routing and take_window_undo_manager_commands. crates/incular-desktop: drains into DesktopPlatformServices::apply_undo_manager_command (default drop).
harness: none: no frame-observable difference without a native undo source.
api_change: added UndoDirection, UndoManagerCommand, PlatformEvent::Undo, Runtime::handle_platform_undo, Runtime::take_undo_manager_commands, Application::take_window_undo_manager_commands, DesktopPlatformServices::apply_undo_manager_command
limitations: No Incular host runs on iOS, so no native UIUndoManager bridge exists; desktop hosts drop SetUndoState as Flutter does.
note: PlatformEvent gained a variant (exhaustive matches outside the workspace must add an arm).

root_cause: No spell check service, configuration or misspelled-word styling; text fields laid out and painted one style, and no text decorations were painted anywhere.
change: crates/incular-platform/src/spell_check.rs: SuggestionSpan, SpellCheckResults (suggestion_span_at), SpellCheckService, DefaultSpellCheckService (native forwarding, merge_results, no-op without native). crates/incular-widgets/src/spell_check.rs: SpellCheckConfiguration, build_text_span_with_spell_check_suggestions (_correctSpellCheckResults, composing/non-composing subtrees), SpellCheckSession. EditableText::spell_check_configuration; user edits request checks (reconciliation.rs sync_spell_check); text layout uses styled runs; refresh_text_fields relayouts on answers; text field paint uses per-run colors and paints run decorations (solid/double/dotted/dashed/wavy).
api_change: added SuggestionSpan, SpellCheckResults, SpellCheckService, SpellCheckCallback, DefaultSpellCheckService, SpellCheckConfiguration, build_text_span_with_spell_check_suggestions, EditableText::spell_check_configuration, WidgetTree::text_field_spell_check_results (doc-hidden)
limitations: No suggestions toolbar or misspelledSelectionColor; no native checker exists in any host; decoration metrics use SkParagraph fallbacks; Text/RichText decorations are still unpainted.

root_cause: No predictive back event, back gesture observers or route that follows gesture progress.
change: crates/incular-platform/src/back_gesture.rs: SwipeEdge, PredictiveBackEvent (new, from_android, is_button_event), BackGestureEvent, PlatformEvent::BackGesture. crates/incular-widgets/src/back_gesture.rs: BackGestureObserver, add_back_gesture_observer/add_shared_back_gesture_observer, dispatch_back_gesture. crates/incular-navigation/src/predictive_back.rs: Navigator handle_start/update/commit/cancel_back_gesture, user_gesture_in_progress, pop_gesture_enabled, observe_back_gestures. crates/incular-runtime: Runtime::handle_back_gesture and window routing.
harness: none: Flutter's events need an Android embedder.
api_change: added SwipeEdge, PredictiveBackEvent, BackGestureEvent, PlatformEvent::BackGesture (new variant), BackGestureObserver, BackGestureObserverRegistration, add_back_gesture_observer, add_shared_back_gesture_observer, dispatch_back_gesture, Navigator back gesture methods, Runtime::handle_back_gesture
limitations: No Android runner emits the events; an unfollowed commit returns false for the host to treat as an ordinary back; commit reverse continues from the gesture value; no Material predictive back visual.
note: Android BackEventCompat mapping lives in incular-platform because incular-android may depend only on incular-accessibility.

root_cause: No platform view identities, commands, widget or placement reports; the renderer models only Incular-drawn content.
change: crates/incular-platform/src/platform_view.rs: PlatformViewId, next_platform_view_id, PlatformViewCommand (Create, Place, Pointer, SetDirection, ClearFocus, Dispose), PlatformViewPointerEvent, PlatformViewCompositing. crates/incular-widgets/src/platform_view.rs: PlatformViewController, PlatformViewSurface (biggest size, raw pointer forwarding), PlatformViewHitTestBehavior, PlatformViewPlacement; WidgetTree::platform_view_placements over a tracked index. crates/incular-runtime: sync_platform_views after paint, take_platform_view_commands, Application::take_window_platform_view_commands. crates/incular-desktop: DesktopPlatformServices::apply_platform_view_command (drops) and platform_view_compositing (Unsupported).
harness: none: Flutter's platform views need a native embedder.
api_change: added platform view types in incular-platform and incular-widgets, WidgetTree::platform_view_placements, Runtime::take_platform_view_commands, Application::take_window_platform_view_commands, DesktopPlatformServices::platform_view_compositing and apply_platform_view_command (defaulted)
limitations: Infeasible on WGPU: a native view cannot be composited into the Incular surface (no texture or hybrid composition); at best a host places it above the surface. No host implements placement: Winit has no portable child-view API and there is no mobile runner. Pointers are forwarded raw, without gesture arena arbitration.
note: Visible bounds clip to ancestor bounds as hit testing does.
